# P05 reader-feature fixtures

The [IsOS owner contract](../../../../../docs/isos/interfaces/packages/verification.md) defines the target behavior. `cases.json` freezes 45 implementation cases. Each case has a stable `id`, operation, named mutation and an `expected` result. `reader_preflight` is an isolated P05 identity check: `admit_reader_only` never means public Run succeeded while R02 gateway readiness is absent. EGIA setup alone advertises exact graph/type IDs; EGIA runtime advertises features without graph/type arrays. Rejection cases require the exact code, stage, graph JSON Pointer, selected binary ID, requested feature when applicable, unchanged saved bytes and zero stop/spawn calls. Restart failures additionally assert unchanged active child PIDs. The baseline graph is the existing `0.1.0` edge fixture; implementations construct the named target starter, MuJoCo and legacy variants from their registered owner catalogs. The fixture file is declarative design evidence, not a claim that P05 runtime behavior already passes.

Positive cases cover an exact EOS starter, safe scalar-only legacy read, a graph-independent HTTP bridge, EGIA's registered legacy IDs inside a `0.1.0` envelope, and a verified MuJoCo package contribution loaded for setup/launch through `--node-types`, a sidecar-free EOS capability probe, and a legacy MuJoCo child with the runtime feature. Negatives cover G01/G03 precedence, known graph and registered type omission from selected arrays, malformed/partial array fallback, conditional features including an enabled bridge without Vision, legacy backend rejection before P05, exact process path and binary identity, package pin and receipt changes, selected binary changes after Apply, and EGIA runtime no-array/no-bootstrap and interpreter/module provenance boundaries. A target feature missing on the exact selected child cannot be cleared by probing a sibling binary. The upgrade cases require exact verified release evidence and prohibit an install or selection side effect from `version check`.

Implementations should use a fresh `ISOS_HOME`, stub selected setup/runtime probes with fixed hashes, and a verified `island/mujoco-sim@0.1.1` sidecar for package cases. For Run/Restart rejection, begin with a live EOS-only deployment and assert the active revision and PID set are unchanged. Test both `isos version check --json` and HTTP/CLI admission surfaces. Keep full outputs under ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`; use the commands and expected assertions in the owner contract before closing P05. Validate the fixture with `python3 tests/fixtures/reader_features/check_cases.py`.
